newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke hits 4-year high in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke hits 4-year high in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares in UK leisure group Ladbroke Plc hit their highest level in over four years on Wednesday and were among the most active in London.
The stock ended the day up 5p at 223-1/2p -- its highest level since June 1992 -- in volume of nearly 13 million shares which included two large agency cross trades.
Sentiment was helped by the successful launch of a new betting game on Monday that Ladbroke was involved in, but most analysts were baffled by the flurry of interest in the shares.
"I haven't got a clue what's behind it," said one industry analyst. "There's no price sensitive news around."
Most dealers cited technical reasons such as "bed and breakfasting' -- traders selling stock then buying it back, for tax reasons.
One analyst, who declined to be identified, put the interest down to developments in Ladbroke's link-up with Hilton Hotels Corp, scheduled for early next year.
The analyst said Ladbroke's decision not to pay out a sum of around 4.3 million stg to a sports and arts foundation could also have helped the stock.
